A '''hover taxi''' was a simple public [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] sled used to travel short distances. Used by the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used one of these on his way to [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze's]] [[Sundari Royal Palace|palace]]. When searching for links on [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] used a hover taxi to visit bars.
